changelog:
Initial release – focused skill for sales data analysis and reporting.

- Added four core tools: query_sales_data, plot_sales_data, analyze_sales_trend, and generate_pdf_report.
- Supports querying, visualizing, and analyzing sales data, as well as generating PDF business reports.
- Included flexible parameters for each tool to address common business analysis needs.
- Provides in-depth sales insights and chart generation for both sales and profit metrics.
